goal: ordinary paid Studio / Studio Assist Growth Studio and Trending

ordinary-account.title: Current ordinary paid Studio / Studio Assist
requirements: Existing studio/assist plan terms; active provider-confirmed paid subscription/entitlement; current live paid invoice.
Acceptance principal is neither Founder/ops nor a provider app-role user. Fixture, trial and manual grants cannot certify ordinary paid production.

membership-isolation.title: Workspace role, isolation and fresh authentication
requirements: Owner/editor/read actions must follow existing permissions. Second workspace, fresh/populated states and revoked membership are separately verified.

growth-lane-flags.title: Independent Growth lane activation
requirements: Only the flag for the requested lane is a dependency. Genome and Post Doctor do not require Meta native analytics.

ai-consent-budget.title: Explicit AI routes, action consent and cumulative cost ceilings
requirements: Owner route consent, separate confirmed action, configured approved finite per-workspace/global budgets, reservations and unknown-cost reconciliation. No model dispatch by acceptance tooling.

native-provider-rights.title: Public-customer native provider eligibility
requirements: Matching app advanced/public approval and current exact scopes, connected account Direct capability, token expiry/revocation fences; app-role grant is insufficient for public access.

approved-publication.title: Exact approved owned public publication
requirements: Verified provider publication of approved exact content/account/timing, frozen draft prediction and provider lookup. No fixture or READY claim.

native-horizons.title: Persistent native observations at actual horizons
requirements: 1h, 24h, 7d are measured from real verified anchor; persist missing/expired windows and retries. Never rebuild old windows from a current lifetime counter.

comments-consent.title: Explicit comment analysis consent
requirements: Owner explicitly permits comment collection/analysis and synthesis routes; handles/contact patterns removed; revoke/purge fences preserved.

owned-comments.title: Collected comments on verified owned posts
requirements: Provider + connection + post ownership and Direct comments capability. Real comments required for production evidence.

calibration-qualification.title: Existing chronological calibration minima
requirements: At least existing 50-post sample and qualified chronological held-out correlations for at least three dimensions; do not lower thresholds.

genome-samples.title: Selected consented writing/history samples
requirements: 1–20 explicitly selected owned consented posts (existing maximum20, not a minimum20); retention and evidence grading unchanged. Writing samples are independent of native Meta history.

public-share-approval.title: Approved public Content DNA sharing
requirements: Concrete public content/access approved before share; creation of private preview is not publication.

draft-revision-fence.title: Exact draft snapshot and allowances
requirements: Current draft revision/prediction/factuality protected through retries and rewrite; entitlement, consent and cap rechecked.

history-consent.title: Separate 90-day History Import consent
requirements: Exact account and consentDigest; bounded 90 days / 12 pages / 300 posts, dedupe, single backfill snapshot only; purge on revoke.

source-rights.title: Per-source provider policy and source entitlements
requirements: Each source is independently qualified by supported provider operation/review/licence, current rights and workspace source entitlements. Unsupported sources stay unavailable.

trend-lane-flags.title: Independent Trending lane activation
requirements: Existing lane flags, tenant admission and provider-operation caps. Native Meta unavailability does not block independently qualified Bluesky/Mastodon or other licensed sources.

trust-qualification.title: Current Trust Receipts and evidence provenance
requirements: Valid rights/time/receipt basis, evidence freshness, current source, expiry/revocation and explainable native normalization; no stale/reconstructed claims.

notification-consent.title: Watches and notification delivery rights
requirements: Explicit workspace watch/notification opt-in, exact channels/recipient scope, permissions, rights and dedupe; not implicit permission to send external messages.

failure-recovery.title: Durable bounded failure/expiry/revocation and rollback
requirements: Private PostgreSQL leases/retry/idempotency/cancellation, purge and rollout flags; real production failures separately observed without inducing unapproved effects.

anonymous-auth.title: Production authentication denial
requirements: No session needed; actual production Growth/Trends GET must deny401/403 without leaking tenant data.

ai-policy-disclosure.title: Current consent/routes/allowance policy
requirements: Read-only policy, explicit owner consent and revocation controls do not require a paid model attempt; actual dispatch uses ai-consent-budget separately.

native-metric-catalog.title: Native metric definitions
requirements: Display real provider definitions, unsupported/unknown distinctions and windows. Reading definitions does not require a publication or model call.

retained-postmortem.title: Current retained Postmortem
requirements: A previously qualified report with current native rights/context and consent bindings; review/save/dismiss do not trigger another model attempt.

retained-audience.title: Current retained Audience insights
requirements: A previously qualified redacted comment result, current ownership/provider/consent/expiry. Filtering/saving/linking is local and does not need a new paid dispatch.

retained-genome.title: Consented current Genome proposal/version
requirements: Prior qualified sample/model provenance plus explicit owner review/version/restore; no new paid generation for read, approval or restore.

saturation-qualification.title: Saturation own semantic cohort qualification
requirements: Current crowding method/model/task/cohort qualification, review, comparison scope, expiry and rights. Preserve existing saturation thresholds; Forecast/Whitespace qualification is not its dependency.

whitespace-qualification.title: Whitespace own review and retrieval qualification
requirements: Current gap_review production method, reviewed contribution and provenance-bound comparison/disconfirming evidence; existing retrieval coverage/rights gates. No Forecast dependency; executable_ready is not empirical outcome qualification.

forecast-qualification.title: Forecast preregistration and chronological outcome qualification
requirements: Qualified immutable candidate/evaluation/qualification/preregistration methods; real chronological holdout, exact predeclared min_episodes/min_pairs, primary loss, embargo and coverage tolerance. Fixture or shadow result does not enable forecast wording.

trend-semantic-qualification.title: Trend Genome semantic admission
requirements: Current trend semantic task/model/cohort review, evidence bindings, narrative uncertainty and nonfixture qualification. Creator Genome1–20-owned-post cap is unrelated.

opportunity-qualification.title: Opportunity own current receipt and workspace-fit qualification
requirements: Current typed opportunity method/semantic authority, receipt/context/fact review and source policy; require Forecast/Saturation only if this actual opportunity cites them.

retained-trend-result.title: Current stored receipt/result
requirements: Current nonexpired stored source, signed receipt, scope/context/revision and applicable specific method qualification. Read/accept/dismiss/handoff does not itself generate AI.

fresh-empty-failure-ui.title: Fresh and failure UI independent of positive data
requirements: Navigation, disclosures, empty/error/Unsupported states remain usable with absent provider data. Their success never certifies real positive acquisition or data-qualified outputs.
